CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFSETTING

CFSETTING changes how the rest of the request is processed. Its most popular use is ENABLECFOUTPUTONLY, which suppresses everything that is not inside a CFOUTPUT block, so that the blank lines left behind by CFSET, CFQUERY and friends do not bloat your page.

Category

Output and page processing

Syntax

<CFSETTING ENABLECFOUTPUTONLY="Yes/No"
    SHOWDEBUGOUTPUT="Yes/No"
    CATCHEXCEPTIONSBYPATTERN="Yes/No">

Attributes

ENABLECFOUTPUTONLY
Optional. "Yes" suppresses all text outside CFOUTPUT blocks; "No" switches it back off.
SHOWDEBUGOUTPUT
Optional, default "Yes". "No" hides the debugging information that the Administrator would otherwise append to the end of this page. It cannot turn debugging on if the Administrator has it off.
CATCHEXCEPTIONSBYPATTERN
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it and always picks the CFCATCH block whose TYPE matches the error, in the order the blocks appear.

Usage

ENABLECFOUTPUTONLY settings nest: each "Yes" must be balanced by a matching "No", so a custom tag or included template can switch it on and off without upsetting its caller. Put the matching "No" at the end of the template, or the rest of the request stays silent.

CFSILENT is the 4.5 alternative for a single block of code. CFPROCESSINGDIRECTIVE compresses whitespace without hiding anything.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSETTING ENABLECFOUTPUTONLY="Yes">
This sentence is outside CFOUTPUT, so you will not see it.
<CFSET Today = Now()>
<CFQUERY NAME="Depts" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT Dept_Name, Location FROM Departments ORDER BY Dept_Name
</CFQUERY>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>With ENABLECFOUTPUTONLY on, only CFOUTPUT text reaches the browser.
Today is #DateFormat(Today, "dddd, mmmm d, yyyy")#.</P>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
</CFOUTPUT>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="Depts"><TR><TD>#Dept_Name#</TD><TD>#Location#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
<CFOUTPUT></TABLE></CFOUTPUT>
<CFSETTING ENABLECFOUTPUTONLY="No">
<P>ENABLECFOUTPUTONLY is off again, so plain text shows up as usual.</P>

See also
